new_page.description: Grandview, South Surrey and White Rock houses for sale: listings, sales and sales ratio for October 2026. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®.
new_page.h1: Grandview Houses for Sale | South Surrey and White Rock Real Estate

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Grandview. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Grandview, South Surrey and White Rock: 67 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 3%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 5 of 9 South Surrey and White Rock communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the South Surrey and White Rock total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Grandview fell from 71 in June to 67 in October (−5.6%), and 39 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 11.8% of South Surrey and White Rock’s 570 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Grandview?
Grandview also had 143 condos and townhomes listed and 23 sold in October, against 67 houses listed. The Grandview condos and townhomes page has those figures.

items.t: Grandview Heights covers about 1,050 hectares, 16 to 28 Avenue, ALR land east.
North Grandview Heights is a separate older plan area north of 28 Avenue.

items.t: Houses were built plan area by plan area; Morgan Heights (Area 1) was planned first.
The east is farmland-edge stock: Darts Hill south of 20 Avenue, east of 168 Street; Redwood Heights east of Highway 15.

blocks.text: Grandview home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

78 houses sold in Grandview with a median price of $1,782,500 (the middle half sold between $1,526,250 and $2,041,250), taking a median of 42 days to sell at 96.1% of the last list price; 1% sold above list. They had a median $514 per square foot, a median year built of 2018 and a median lot of 4,014 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Grandview?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 67 houses listed in Grandview. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Grandview a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Grandview had a sales ratio of 3%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Grandview from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 39 houses sold in Grandview over those 5 months, out of 294 in all of South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Grandview?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: Which secondary school serves a Grandview house?
faq.a: Usually Grandview Heights Secondary at 16987 25 Avenue, but not for every address in the plan area. The district's December 4, 2020 letter lists six feeder elementary schools, and a district handout notes Edgewood is split by address with Earl Marriott Secondary. Check the Locator.

faq.q: Which elementary schools are inside Grandview Heights?
faq.a: Edgewood and Sunnyside sit inside the plan area, at 16666 23 Avenue and 2828 159 Street, with the secondary school at 16987 25 Avenue. Location is not catchment: the district sets catchment by home address through its School Locator tool, so confirm the exact address before buying.

No — the last plan area only started planning in 2026. Council authorized staff on July 13, 2026 to initiate the Area 5 Neighbourhood Concept Plan, with a Stage 1 draft land use plan expected in early 2027 and Stage 2 servicing targeted for spring 2028.

faq.q: When did the local schools open?
faq.a: Both are new buildings from the growth period: Edgewood Elementary opened in January 2021 and Grandview Heights Secondary in September 2021, per City planning reports, and the district growth plan names a future Redwood Heights Elementary as the east side builds out.

faq.q: What did houses in Grandview sell for?
faq.a: 78 houses sold in Grandview between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,782,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Grandview?
faq.a: The median was 42 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.1% of the last list price (1% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
